seoTitle: BMI Calculator - Check Your Body Mass Index Online
metaDescription: Free online BMI Calculator. Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) instantly using your height and weight. Discover if you are in a healthy weight range.
intro: Want to know if your weight is healthy for your height? Our free BMI Calculator instantly computes your Body Mass Index using standard World Health Organization categories.
whatIs: The BMI (Body Mass Index) Calculator is a health screening tool. It uses a mathematical formula based on your height and weight to estimate your total body fat and categorize your health risk.
howToUse: Select your preferred measurement system (Metric or Imperial).
Enter your height (in cm or feet/inches).
Enter your weight (in kg or pounds).
The tool calculates your exact BMI and displays your health category.
howItWorks: The tool uses the standard formula: weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared (kg/m²). For imperial inputs, it calculates (pounds / inches²) × 703 before categorizing the result.
workedExample: A person who is 1.75 meters tall and weighs 70 kilograms: 70 / (1.75 × 1.75) = 70 / 3.0625 = 22.86. A BMI of 22.86 falls into the 'Normal/Healthy Weight' category.
resultInterpretation: The number provides a general indicator of health. Below 18.5 is Underweight; 18.5 to 24.9 is Normal; 25.0 to 29.9 is Overweight; 30.0 and above is Obese.
useCases: Personal Health: Tracking your BMI over time as you begin a new diet or exercise regimen.
Medical Screenings: Doctors using BMI as a fast initial screening tool to identify potential weight-related health risks.
Fitness Planning: Setting a realistic target weight based on the 'Normal' BMI range for your height.
tipsAndLimitations: BMI does not directly measure body fat percentage. It cannot distinguish between fat and muscle.
Highly muscular athletes may score as 'Obese' on a BMI scale despite having very low body fat, because muscle is denser than fat.

faq.question: Is BMI accurate for everyone?
faq.answer: No. While it is a good general guide for the average population, it is inaccurate for pregnant women, heavily muscled athletes, and the elderly.

faq.question: Does gender affect BMI?
faq.answer: The standard adult BMI formula does not factor in gender. However, women naturally carry a slightly higher body fat percentage than men at the same BMI.

disclaimer: This tool provides general health estimates based on WHO standards. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice or diagnosis.
